# OpenTimeline media directory<AvailableFrom v="4.0.543" />

Directory containing the media referenced by an OpenTimelineIO file. Defaults to the directory containing the timeline. Missing absolute paths are also looked up by filename in this directory.

## CLI flag

```text
--media-dir <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion open-timeline import`](/docs/cli/open-timeline/import)
